verdict.rationale: The homepage says Speech is Cheap publishes accuracy results so people can evaluate transcription performance before integrating. Nothing in the pack shows those results come with a methodology, test conditions, or a benchmark dataset a founder could check. That leaves only a thin claim that results exist, not that they are verifiable. Missing for 10: documented benchmark methodology, named or downloadable benchmark dataset, reproducible metrics (e.g. WER by language or condition), independent corroboration of the published numbers.
